messages:
sam: deploy-bot kicked off a eu-west canary for v2026.03.21 (10% traffic). flagged small p95 spike in the dashboard. anyone watching?

deploy-bot: deploy event: v2026.03.21-canary -> service/inference-eu (traffic=10%). run: https://deploys.redwood/1732102468

nora: pulling telemetry now. which metric panel?

sam: p95 and p99 on route /v1/generate. p99 jumped from ~120ms -> ~900ms around 1732102400.

sre_oncall: traces show many short requests queuing on GPU scheduling. KV hits normal. I see a new runtime flag in this release: continuous_batching=true.

paul: if the flag is the culprit we should avoid a full rollback of the model; prefer a targeted flag revert. can we stop the rollout and pin to stable?

ops_lead: my vote is stop the ramp, set canary traffic to 0% and keep instances alive for postmortem. get consensus.

sam: ok propose: STOP rollout -> set traffic 0% for eu-west -> investigate -> if infra flag implicated, revert on canary -> test at 5%. anyone object?

nora: no objection. I'll capture heap/kern stats and attach traces with rollout_id=1732102468.

deploy-bot: action: traffic update requested by sam. setting v2026.03.21-canary traffic to 0% in eu-west. (id=rb-1732102468-01)

paul: vote: stop + pin. prepping flag-revert command.

sre_oncall: vote: stop. recommending flag revert on canary infra group and 10m observation window.

ops_lead: agreed. nora, sam, once we have evidence of scheduling pressure from batching, flip the flag on canary only. keep stable version serving.

nora: evidence looks convincing - short-span spikes align with batch aggregation windows. tagging traces.

paul: command ready to apply: ```kubectl patch configmap infra-flags -n inference --type=merge -p '{"data":{"continuous_batching":"false"}}'``` will stage to canary infra group.

sam: do it. jen not in thread so running through ops_lead.

deploy-bot: config patch applied to canary infra (infra-flags) for inference-eu group. monitor window 300s.

sre_oncall: p99 sliding back toward baseline within ~90s of patch. good sign. keep traffic at 0% while we validate.

ops_lead: after 10m stable, we will attempt a controlled re-launch at 5% with batching disabled. counsel: do not change other flags.

nora: collecting additional perf dumps and kernel timers for 15m. tagging with incident=canary-latency-1732102468.

paul: updating release notes draft: "Temporarily disabled continuous batching in EU canary due to observed tail latency. No model rollback performed. Investigation ongoing."

sam: thanks. will update the changelog and notify product.

deploy-bot: note appended to run 1732102468: "canary paused - p95/p99 tail; continuous_batching toggled off on canary infra; waiting 10m stability window"

ops_lead: decision log: STOP -> pin -> infra-flag revert on canary -> monitor 10m -> if stable, resume at 5% then follow rollout policy.

sre_oncall: will reopen if we see recurrence. good catch everyone. :thumbsup:
